MESSAGE: Since you're new to here, why don't I show you around?
See that shop over by where Nano's standing?
You get gold for beating monsters outside the town and you can spend it on stuff like additional healing items and gear.
We also just got that save point over there.
Walk up to it and press "Z" to get a code you can use to resume your game later.
it is very important to save, because when your game ends, the only way you can come back is through the save point.
Anyway, I've got something to attend to in the woods so if you could come by and help out, that would be great.
Thanks for coming to help out.
So, I'm almost finished, but could you bring me that gear over there?
You're not going any further w...
Now's not the time for that you two!
Right. I saw what you did back in the forest, and I don't much appreciate anyone interfering with our actions.
I knew you guys were trouble from the very start! Anyone who interferes with our plans will be destroyed.
Thanks! Now I have all the parts for this to start.
Come back later once I get it working.
This building behind me is the shop.
You can pack a serious punch with the stuff that's inside.
Have you heard of Pico's 'Green' brand of clothing?
Be careful out there in the forest.
Some of the monsters that live out there are really dangerous if you're not prepared.
This sign was put here at the request of countless citizens demanding to know how to enter the shop.
To enter the shop one must position themselves in front of the wooden rectangular object (also known as a door) and walk towards it.
Pseudo Cave - leads to Boolean Town
